title: Saving the Spring Flow
transcript: In the mountain villages we visited, the problem was timing. Springs flowed strongly after the snow melted, but households needed that supply well into the dry months. At the first village, a stone channel carried spring water across a slope into a communal tank. A mesh screen at the inlet caught leaves before they entered. To learn how much the tank level fell each day, a caretaker read a painted scale on the inside wall at dawn. Over the summer, the fastest drops came on days when several gardens were irrigated at once, even when the spring was still flowing steadily. The committee had been discussing a larger tank. The records suggested that it should first ask households to water on different days and see whether that kept the reserve above its minimum level.

questions.prompt: Spring water crossed the slope in a stone ____.
questions.explanation: 石砌水渠沿山坡把泉水引入公共储水池。

questions.prompt: Leaves were caught by a mesh ____ at the inlet.
questions.explanation: 进水口的滤网在树叶进入储水池前将其拦住。

questions.prompt: The caretaker read a painted ____ at dawn.
questions.explanation: 管理员每天清晨读取内壁上漆绘的刻度，记录水位变化。

questions.prompt: When did the stored supply fall fastest?
options: When the spring flow slowed most sharply
When several gardens were watered on the same day
When only one garden was watered at dawn
questions.answer: When several gardens were watered on the same day
questions.explanation: 几个菜园同日灌溉时，即使泉水流量稳定，储水池的水位也下降得最快。

questions.prompt: What do the records suggest the committee should try first?
options: Increase the volume of the communal tank.
Allocate the same quantity of water to each garden.
Spread garden watering across different days.
questions.answer: Spread garden watering across different days.
questions.explanation: 记录表明委员会可以先试行分日灌溉，观察储水量能否维持在最低水平以上。
